jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

Join us as a Cybersecurity Transformation Program Lead (f/m/d) and drive a strategic product cybersecurity program across Germany or Norway. You will connect IEC 62443, the EU Cyber Resilience Act, NIS2, cloud cybersecurity, governance, and customer requirements into one scalable framework. You will turn strategic goals into clear workstreams and coordinate delivery across product management, engineering, cloud operations, service, quality, legal, and cybersecurity teams. Your work will help protect market access, reduce regulatory and operational risk, support compliance, and build a sustainable cybersecurity capability across the organization.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Leadership of the program roadmap, workstreams, milestones, priorities, resources, governance, KPIs, budgets, risks, and compliance status
* Translation of cybersecurity goals into clear deliverables with accountable ownership, and preparation of reports and decision proposals for senior management
* Coordination of implementation of CRA, NIS2, and IEC 62443 requirements, including support for certification and recertification activities
* Integration of cybersecurity requirements into PLM, development, release, service, cloud, and vulnerability-management processes
* Collaboration with product management, engineering, cloud operations, service, quality, legal, and cybersecurity teams to align roles, resolve conflicts, and support communication, training, and change activities

What You Bring

* A degree in cybersecurity, computer science, engineering, business information systems, or a comparable discipline; equivalent professional experience is also welcome
* Several years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, engineering, compliance, or program management, including several years leading complex, cross-functional technical programs or transformations
* Strong working knowledge of IEC 62443 and the EU Cyber Resilience Act, plus a good understanding of NIS2, secure product development, vulnerability management, and cloud-security governance
* Experience with regulatory, standards-based, or certification requirements, ideally in product or industrial cybersecurity and internationally distributed organizations
* Fluent business English; German or other relevant languages are beneficial

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to a competitive, market-based compensation package, you can expect an attractive employer-funded retirement plan
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder at very attractive employee terms
* Under our motto #BetterTogether, we offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely. Our offices, too, leave nothing to be desired and provide space for inspiring collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. With us, you’ll have the opportunity to learn and grow on your own terms. A variety of attractive programs and initiatives are available to support this
* When it comes to “work-life balance,” we offer a wide range of options, such as flexible work schedules, childcare facilities at many locations, the option to try part-time work on a trial basis, and even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLEERC is bringing Victor, our hybrid-electric heavy-lift cargo UAS, to military operators and customers to enable critical missions when roads, runways, or crewed aviation are unavailable, impractical, or operationally constrained. In this role, you will drive the introduction of this new capability based on a clear view of customer missions, capability needs, procurement pathways, and operational constraints.
You will build and own ERC's relationships with the Armed Forces of Germany, NATO partners, and global allies. Combining strategic market development, hands-on key account ownership, and capture execution, you will turn operational needs into qualified opportunities, test and evaluation projects, and contracts. In pursuing your mission, you will be working closely with our Commercial Leadership as well as Product, Engineering, Flight Operations, and Communications.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Develop account and market-entry plans for Germany and selected NATO/allied markets
• Build, maintain, and expand durable relationships with military users, capability planners, procurement stakeholders, prime contractors, and operational units
• Identify and qualify defence opportunities ahead of formal tenders; maintain account plans, develop opportunity-specific capture plans, and set pipeline priorities
• Drive opportunities from initial engagement to contract signature, including customer briefings, requirement shaping, proposal development, offer coordination, negotiations, and follow-up
• Navigate military procurement processes and coordinate complex stakeholder landscapes across end users, requirements owners, procurement bodies, industry partners, and internal teams
• Work closely with Product, Engineering, Flight Operations, and Leadership to translate operational needs into mission concepts, demonstration narratives, product requirements, and commercially viable solutions
• Support the planning and execution of product demonstrations, trade fairs, and industry events; and represent ERC at customer meetings, delegation visits, demonstrations, field exercises, trade fairs, and defence events.

WHAT YOU BRING
• Approximately 5 years of experience in business development, key account management, or sales, ideally in the defence or governmental sector or in complex B2B enterprise sales
• A proven record of developing and closing complex opportunities with military, governmental, defence-industry, or enterprise customers
• Strong commercial judgement and the ability to combine account strategy with hands-on project execution
• Excellent communication, stakeholder-management, and negotiation skills, including with senior military, governmental, and industrial counterparts in English and German
• A strong understanding of the German defence ecosystem and acquisition pathways
• A structured and ownership-oriented working style
• Authorization to work in Germany, the eligibility to obtain the appropriate security clearances as may be required; and willingness to travel.

Moreover, it would be helpful if you also
• bring an active network among military users, requirements owners, and procurement stakeholders
• are familiar with military procurement processes of NATO and allied countries.

ERC particularly encourages veterans and former military service members to apply for this position.

WHAT WE OFFER
• Full-scale aerospace engineering, not concept slides
• A 60+ engineer team at Ottobrunn
• Real ownership and flat hierarchies: a modern startup culture where your input shapes decisions, not just execution
• Flexible working hours, remote work, and competitive compensation
• Health & wellbeing: EGYM Wellpass membership and subsidized lunch in our canteen
• Office extras: espresso coffee, fresh fruit, and soft drinks, plus regular team and company events, and plenty more once you're on board

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

Location: Dreieich / Remote, Germany. Territory: Southern Germany (Bavaria and Baden Wuertemberg).
Travel: Approximately 50%.

Discover Impactful Work
We are looking for an Account Manager (m/f/d), Materials & Surface Analysis to drive profitable growth across assigned customers and markets in Southern Germany.

This is a highly dynamic sales role with strong connections to technical, marketing, service and other commercial functions. You will develop strategic customer relationships, understand customer priorities and position Thermo Fisher Scientific solutions to address their scientific and business needs.

The portfolio includes Electron Microscopy (EM), X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy (XPS), software, services and related analytical workflows. These core technologies are complemented by adjacent techniques such as Energy-Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (EDS), Electron Backscatter Diffraction (EBSD), Raman Spectroscopy, Ion Scattering Spectroscopy (ISS), Electron Energy Loss Spectroscopy (EELS), and others.

A Day in the Life:
You will thrive in this role if you enjoy working in a multidisciplinary, highly technical environment where collaboration, customer engagement and continuous personal development are essential to success.

As part of our Sales and Service organization, you will identify and understand customer needs, develop your market and use your technical expertise and product knowledge to build effective sales strategies. You will create customer presentations, respond to tenders, recommend suitable product solutions and drive opportunities through to successful closure.

Using your technical knowledge and strong interpersonal skills, you will engage effectively with both prospective and existing customers. You will own the full sales cycle—from lead generation and opportunity development through negotiation and closure.

Success in this role requires close collaboration with a broad network of colleagues, including our NanoPort demonstration facilities, product specialists, marketing professionals, fellow Account Managers, service teams and other business functions.

What to expect:

- Develop and strengthen strategic relationships with assigned customers and markets.
- Understand customer priorities and position Thermo Fisher Scientific solutions to create measurable value.
- Own and manage the complete sales cycle from lead identification through closure.
- Identify customer needs, market trends and new business opportunities.
- Apply technical expertise and product knowledge to develop effective sales strategies.
- Prepare and deliver compelling customer presentations and commercial proposals.
- Respond to tenders and recommend the most appropriate product and workflow solutions.
- Build and maintain a healthy opportunity pipeline and accurate sales forecast.
- Collaborate closely with NanoPort colleagues, product specialists, marketing, service teams, peer Account Managers and other business functions.
- Maintain strong CRM and commercial discipline throughout the sales process.
- Travel approximately 50% within the assigned territory.

Keys to Success:
Education

- Typically, an M.Sc. degree or higher in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics or a related scientific or technical field.

Experience

- Demonstrated familiarity with XPS, electron microscopy, spectroscopy, imaging or related analytical instrumentation is required.
- Previous client-facing commercial experience is required.
- Experience working successfully within a matrix organization, with responsibility for clear and effective communication across teams, is highly valuable.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

- Business-fluent German is required.
- Business-fluent English is required.
- Additional languages are welcome but not essential.
- Proactive, self-motivated and comfortable taking ownership.
- Strong interpersonal skills and an openness to working across cultures and diverse teams.
- Confident communicator in customer meetings, presentations and public-speaking settings.
- Clear, open and effective communication style.
- Ability to develop and maintain strong internal and external customer relationships.
- Ability to articulate how our technologies support materials science applications and create value for customers.
- Strong ability to prioritize requirements and meet or exceed customer expectations.
- Commitment to continuously developing commercial skills and improving sales processes.
- Strong CRM discipline and willingness to work within established business processes.

Benefits:
We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!

Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need.

#StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.

Apply today! http://jobs.thermofisher.com (http://jobs.thermofisher.com)

We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform at Smartly!

Smartly is building the standard path for governed data sharing across product services, analytics, and AI/ML. The Data Platform team owns the contracts, control mechanisms, publication paths, catalog metadata, lifecycle rules, lineage, permissions, and runtime building blocks that make reusable data safe and practical at scale.

This is a role for someone who wants to shape a platform early, while working on concrete production problems from the start. Smartly already has the production systems, Kafka backbone, PostgreSQL databases, analytical consumers, and AI/ML use cases that need a better data foundation. The challenge is to turn that reality into a standard path that engineers actually want to use.

Our first milestone is focused: centrally managed publishing tables in service-owned PostgreSQL databases, captured through Debezium CDC into Kafka, and registered in DataHub with ownership, lifecycle, lineage, and impact-analysis metadata. Longer-term, the platform expands toward self-service data products, governed materialisations, durable shared state, and reusable data across Smartly’s operational and analytical systems.

This is not a role where you only maintain an existing reporting pipeline. You will help design and build the platform path that other engineering teams use when they publish and consume shared data.

What you will do

- Design and build platform services, tools, and workflows for contract-driven data publishing and consumption.
- Build the first production path for platform-managed PostgreSQL publishing tables, Debezium CDC, Kafka topics, and catalog registration.
- Create GitOps-style workflows where contracts, schemas, ownership, lifecycle, compatibility, policy metadata, and runtime desired state are reviewed, validated, and reconciled as code.
- Build tooling that gives product engineers fast feedback before they publish or change data products.
- Help define how Smartly models data products, publishing contracts, schema evolution, field stability, deletion semantics, access policy, lineage, and cost attribution.
- Operate and improve the CDC runtime model, including Kubernetes workloads, source-specific isolation, offsets, schema history, heartbeats, signal channels, lag visibility, replay, resnapshotting, and recovery.
- Integrate platform metadata into DataHub so engineers can discover data products, understand ownership, trace lineage, and reason about the impact of changes.
- Work with product, infrastructure, data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML teams to make the standard path easier and safer than bespoke point-to-point integrations.

What we are looking for

- Strong experience building and operating production software systems, preferably in platform, infrastructure, backend, or data-intensive environments.
- Deep understanding of distributed systems trade-offs: reliability, idempotency, replay, eventual consistency, ownership boundaries, compatibility, and operational failure modes.
- Practical experience with PostgreSQL or other relational databases, including schema design, migrations, transactions, replication, or operational performance.
- Experience with Kafka, event streaming, CDC, Debezium, or adjacent data-movement technologies. Direct Debezium experience is valuable, but strong fundamentals matter more.
- Experience building software that other engineers use: CLIs, internal platforms, control planes, automation, CI validation, developer tooling, or self-service workflows.
- Familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud or infrastructure platforms, including runtime isolation, deployment, observability, and operational ownership.
- Ability to turn ambiguous architectural direction into practical increments, make trade-offs explicit, and deliver useful production systems without waiting for perfect certainty.
- Clear written and spoken communication in English. This role involves aligning multiple engineering teams around standards, contracts, and ownership boundaries.

Useful experience, but not required

- DataHub or other data catalog, lineage, or governance systems.
- Open table formats such as Apache Iceberg, object-store-backed data lakes, S3, BigQuery, ClickHouse, or analytical storage systems.
- GitHub Actions, policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code, controllers, operators, or reconciliation-based systems.
- Data contracts, schema registries, Protobuf, Avro, JSON Schema, compatibility checking, field-level metadata, or contract testing.
- Experience supporting analytics, AI/ML, feature-store-style access patterns, or cross-domain product-service integrations.
- Experience with JVM languages and Python, TypeScript, Go, or Ruby.

What we offer you

At Smartly, we offer a place where you can do meaningful technical work while growing with a global team.

- Inclusive global culture built on trust, transparency, open feedback, and respect for different perspectives.
- Global impact through technology used by major brands to plan, create, optimize, and understand digital advertising at scale.
